capture_method: Base medication-level rows are preserved from the 2026-08-18 first-party matrix. Dose enrichment used fresh Firecrawl v2 map + first-party site search + maxAge=0 direct page captures on 2026-08-24, including public pricing, plan, medication, FAQ, and logged-out start pages. No account, login, payment, form, PHI, provider contact, or bot-protection bypass.

dose_capture.current_render_counting_basis: Counted directly from 143 generated public `.p3-dose-grid` card instances x their six current `<li>` rows = 858. Each card is bound to its first displayed medication row for impact accounting. This reports how many current placeholders the evidence can replace; it does not pretend the current universal tirzepatide-style grid is the correct ladder for every medication.

dose_pricing_model_values.flat_all_doses: An explicit first-party quote connects one price to every/all/same/regardless-of-dose; every canonical ladder dose may carry that exact evidenced price.
dose_pricing_model_values.not_published: No attributable dose-pricing model was found on the captured public first-party pages.
dose_pricing_model_values.per_dose: The provider publishes exact dose-price pairs; only those explicit pairs are populated.
dose_pricing_model_values.plan_tiered: The provider publishes multiple plan or commitment prices, but the public evidence does not attribute them to doses.

evidence_rule: A price ships only when a verbatim quote from the captured page contains it. A provider whose captured pages do not publish an attributable per-medication price ships an honest 'pricing unavailable' state - never an estimate.
